all_words.explanation: A consultation is usually run with stakeholders, so the two words belong to the same policy process.
A lantern is a source of light and has no connection to public policy.
Feedback collected during a consultation is its main purpose, so the two words are close in meaning.
A walrus is a marine animal and is unrelated to policy making.
Governments often publish a white paper after a consultation, so the two terms commonly appear together.
A thimble is a sewing tool and is unrelated to public consultation.

explanation: A consultation gathers stakeholder feedback, often before a white paper is published; the other words belong to unrelated fields.
